classification.difficultyReason: Read each diagram, distinguish cups from loose marbles, and form a coefficient of n plus a constant; early parts supply the notation.

content.prompt:
There are $n$ marbles in each cup.

Write an algebraic expression for the total number of marbles in each diagram.

spec.description: One cup with three loose marbles to its right, aligned near the cup's base.
spec.mathematics: One group of n marbles and three additional marbles.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer or pronumeral is drawn in the student figure.

answer.worked: The cup contains $n$ marbles. Adding the 3 loose marbles gives $n+3$.

spec.description: Four identical cups in one horizontal row, with no loose marbles.
spec.mathematics: Four equal groups of n marbles.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer or pronumeral is drawn in the student figure.

answer.worked:
Each of the 4 cups contains $n$ marbles.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Total marbles}&=4\times n\\&=4n\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three identical cups followed by two loose marbles on their right.
spec.mathematics: Three groups of n marbles and two additional marbles.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer or pronumeral is drawn in the student figure.

answer.worked: The 3 cups contain $3n$ marbles. Adding the 2 loose marbles gives $3n+2$.

spec.description: Four identical cups followed by three loose marbles on their right.
spec.mathematics: Four groups of n marbles and three additional marbles.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer or pronumeral is drawn in the student figure.

answer.worked: The 4 cups contain $4n$ marbles. Adding the 3 loose marbles gives $4n+3$.

spec.description: Two identical cups followed by four loose marbles on their right.
spec.mathematics: Two groups of n marbles and four additional marbles.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer or pronumeral is drawn in the student figure.

answer.worked: The 2 cups contain $2n$ marbles. Adding the 4 loose marbles gives $2n+4$.

spec.description: Five identical cups followed by one loose marble on their right.
spec.mathematics: Five groups of n marbles and one additional marble.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer or pronumeral is drawn in the student figure.

answer.worked: The 5 cups contain $5n$ marbles. Adding the loose marble gives $5n+1$.
